notes.title: BattleHeights Patch Notes - V 1.2.0
notes.notes:
📅 Friday, October 7th

This update brings a brand-new Lobby, a revamped UI, a scoreboard, and better character animations to make your battles even more fun and dynamic!

[h1]🌟 The Lobby - A New Waiting Room![/h1]

We’re excited to introduce the BattleHeights Lobby! While waiting for other players to join, you can:
[list]
[*] ✅ Train on different dummies
[*] ✅ Explore and get familiar with the arena
[*] ✅ Hunt the mischievous Pumpkin Men!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218779/400a82c4bce75847178ac5686a522f663c323c13.gif[/img]

The game will automatically start once enough players are online.

[h1]🏆 Scoreboard - Track Your Progress!

The game now features a scoreboard! You can score points by:[/h1]
🗡️ Fighting Pumpkin Men (if you're alone)
⚔️ Battling other players in Team Deathmatch

The scoreboard is visible in the Lobby only. And don't forget our dedicated event: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2932940/view/631167175114096798


[h1]🕺 New Rig - Express Yourself![/h1]

We’ve added a new character rig, bringing:
🎭 Better dance animations
🎯 Visible aiming direction for more precise combat
🙆 Head gestures – now you can even nod “YES”!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218779/135a002e27ea88875997feefc77df7563a5bfd84.gif[/img]

[h1]🎨 UI Improvements - A Fresher Look![/h1]

We’ve polished the HUD and welcome screen for a cleaner and more stylish experience. There's still more to come, so stay tuned for future updates!

Thanks for playing BattleHeights! Jump in and enjoy the new features. 🚀🔥

notes.title: 🎄 Be the KING of the GIFTS this Christmas! 🎄
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=IWjqVYCyv0g;full][/previewyoutube]🎄 CHRISTMAS SPECIAL: Be the KING of the Hill! 🎄

This holiday season, we’re bringing you something magical! From December 20th to January 4th, a special map featuring the King of the Hill game mode will be open for all adventurers.

🎅 Santa’s sleigh has crash-landed on Shiverbones Peak, scattering gifts everywhere! Rally your team, fight to control the point, and claim the exclusive "King of the Gifts" achievement!

📢 Important Notes:

[list]
[*]     The event map will only start if at least 4 players are in the game.
[*]     Plan ahead and coordinate with your teammates, friends, or other players on our Discord: https://dsc.gg/BattleHeights.
[/list]

Don’t miss your chance to be crowned the ultimate King of the Hill in this festive showdown. The gifts are waiting—see you on the Peak!
